mapper.sql: dispatch_seq, center_seq, dispatch_name, delivery_date, dispatch_status_cd, created_at, creator_seq, modified_at, modifier_seq
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dispatch SET center_seq = #{centerSeq}, dispatch_name = #{dispatchName}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate}, dispatch_status_cd = #{dispatchStatusCd}, modified_at = #{modifiedAt}, modifier_seq = #{modifierSeq} WHERE dispatch_seq = #{dispatchSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT a.dispatch_seq, a.dispatch_name, a.delivery_date, a.center_seq, b.center_name, a.dispatch_status_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'DispatchStatus' AND com_code_cd = a.dispatch_status_cd) AS dispatch_status_cd_name FROM t_dispatch a LEFT JOIN t_center b ON a.center_seq = b.center_seq WHERE a.dispatch_seq = #{dispatchSeq}

SELECT a.dispatch_seq, a.dispatch_name, a.delivery_date, a.center_seq, b.center_name, a.dispatch_status_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'DispatchStatus' AND com_code_cd = a.dispatch_status_cd) AS dispatch_status_cd_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_delivery x WHERE x.dispatch_seq = a.dispatch_seq) AS delivery_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_vehicle x WHERE x.center_seq = a.center_seq) AS delivery_vehicle_count FROM t_dispatch a LEFT JOIN t_center b ON a.center_seq = b.center_seq
AND b.center_name LIKE '%' || #{centerName} || '%'
AND a.dispatch_status_cd LIKE '%' || #{centerName} || '%'
ORDER BY a.delivery_date DESC, a.dispatch_seq DESC

SELECT a.dispatch_seq, a.dispatch_name, a.delivery_date, a.center_seq, a.dispatch_status_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'DispatchStatus' AND com_code_cd = a.dispatch_status_cd) AS dispatch_status_cd_name FROM t_dispatch a WHERE a.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_vehicle x WHERE x.center_seq = a.center_seq AND x.driver_seq = #{driverSeq} ) ORDER BY a.dispatch_seq DESC LIMIT 1
